comment: PHIL 101:  this class killed my interest in phil. unorganized class and a LOT of homework like this was my most difficult class to date by far and i didn't really retain any info. if you want to do well you have to go above and beyond. would not recommend. POP QUIZZES AND IN CLASS HAND WRITTEN ESSAYS BEWAREEE

The class at first seemed fun, however, Dr. H is so unorganized it left our entire class confused. There are multiple long readings and they lecture constantly and go on so many tangents. We had written essay exams and pop quizzes. We never receive any feedback and half of us don't know what's going on most of the time. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!

No one understood what was happening in their class. Lectures were unclear and the assignments and papers even more confusing. Reflections and homework every class and lots of work. In meetings, they give the most confusing and unhelpful feedback. Do not take their class.

Dr. H is unclear when giving instructions for assignments. The class worked on final papers throughout the semester and the feedback we received was often confusing and hard to follow. We also had to write reflections after every class for homework. I used to enjoy philosophy and now I hate it.

Dr H is highly unorganized. They lecture in class just to hear themselves talk and assign so many readings. They are very particular on paper but don't make sense. They grade all over the place, do not recommend.

Dr. H is very disorganized & doesn't clearly explain. My class bonded over how confused we were. They micromanage discussions & are nit-picky on assignments. The readings were so long that half of the class, including myself, stopped reading altogether. We had weekly quizzes, reflections after each class, & 1 final paper worth majority of our grade
